comparison.objective: Pull two snap-fit case halves apart and leave them separated on the table.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual opposing grasp and straight pulling through a spring-plunger detent.
comparison.success_condition: Tongue removed, halves flat, stable, and separated by at least 3 cm; all three available spec versions agree materially.
comparison.reason: Generic counterforce is shared, but snap-fit separation does not test a tool, retained rotary adjustment, torque control, or repeated dynamic performance.
